title: 60-Second Reset (Panic Button)
description: Rapid autonomic down-regulation using extended 4/6 vagal breathing.

prompts.text: Feet flat on the floor. Soften your jaw.
Breathe in through nose for 4... exhale slowly through mouth for 6.
Notice the weight of your body supported by the chair.
You are steady. You are here.
Reset complete.

title: Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)
description: Tactical focus reset used under high cognitive stress.

prompts.text: Sit tall. Empty your lungs.
Inhale 4... Hold 4... Exhale 4... Hold empty 4.
Stay relaxed during the holds. Don't strain.
Mind clear. Attention anchored.

title: Physiological Sigh & Slow Exhale
description: Double inhale followed by long sighing exhale to instantly pop open collapsed alveoli and lower heart rate.

prompts.text: Two quick sniffs in through the nose, one long sigh out.
Heart rate slowing. Steady now.

title: Cool-Down After Conflict
description: De-escalate nervous system arousal following an argument or tense confrontation.

prompts.text: Step away from the scene. Loosen your shoulders.
Release the urge to win or retaliate right now.
Your only job in this minute is safety and calm.
Steadier now. What does this situation actually need?

title: Work to Home Shift Handover
description: Deliberately shed workplace vigilance before entering personal and family space.

prompts.text: Close your work tabs. Place your hands in your lap.
Acknowledge today's unfinished work: it will be there tomorrow.
Exhale the armor. Who is waiting for you with love?
Work day complete. Arrive present.

title: Pre-Performance Centering
description: Align nervous arousal from anxiety into calm, directed readiness.

prompts.text: Feel your feet pressing into the floor. Spine tall.
Reframe butterflies as adrenaline preparing you for focus.
One key intention: What is the single gift you want to deliver?
Ready. Step in.
